conformance_note: an earlier revision of this program computed PASS from a subset of the conditions its own frozen predicate named, leaving digest and reload recorded but non-gating. The gap was closed BEFORE this execution; the request bytes, request hash, provider, model, transport, context and generation configuration, timeout and planned N are all byte-identical to the first gate.

environment_diagnostics.note: diagnostic only; §8 forbids an arbitrary VRAM number from itself gating the rerun

next_step_if_pass: PHASE0_FRESH_RERUN_AUTHORISED — execute PHASE0-RUN-3 in a NEW evidence directory with fresh opaque subjects and the same frozen design; no infrastructure work in that round
next_step_if_fail: PHASE0_RERUN_REMAINS_BLOCKED_BY_PROVIDER_ENVIRONMENT. Restoring the environment (closing GPU-consuming applications, restarting the machine) is execution-environment restoration, not a protocol amendment, and the SAME frozen gate may be re-run afterwards.

mid_gate_reload_detection.reason: at most one initial load; the same resident model served every remaining planned probe
mid_gate_reload_detection.detection_scope: detects every unload and every digest change observable at the per-probe sample points, and any second load transition. It does NOT detect a silent unload-and-reload that completes entirely between two sample points while ending resident — that limitation is recorded rather than hidden.
